title: Al Tayer Motors & Premier Motors lead Kia’s next era in the UAE
summary: Strategic partnership to advance Kia's future growth with a continued focus on customers, innovation, and sustainable mobility

contentHtml:
The new partnership reflects Kia's established presence and continued commitment to the UAE. Image Courtesy: Al Tayer Motors

Strategic partnership to advance Kia's future growth with a continued focus on customers, innovation, and sustainable mobility

Press Release

United Arab Emirates: Al Tayer Motors has been appointed the exclusive importer-distributor for Kia in the United Arab Emirates, marking the beginning of a new chapter for the brand and its customers across the country. Premier Motors will represent Kia in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi.

The new partnership reflects Kia's established presence and continued commitment to the UAE bringing together these organisations with a shared focus on customer care, innovation and long-term growth.

“We are proud to welcome Kia customers to the Al Tayer Motors and Premier Motors family,” said Saeed Humaid Al Tayer, Managing Director, Al Tayer Motors. “Kia has built a strong reputation and loyal customer base in the country over many years. We look forward to building further on that foundation to deliver the exceptional standards of care, service and support that customers expect from a forward-looking, world-class dealership.”

Kia offers one of the UAE's most diverse mobility portfolios, spanning passenger vehicles, SUVs, electric vehicles, commercial vehicles, and pickup trucks. The brand continues to expand its line-up in the country and recently introduced the PV5, with additional launches planned this year.

“The appointment of Al Tayer Motors and Premier Motors marks a strategic milestone for Kia in one of the region's most dynamic markets. Their extensive expertise and strong operational capabilities will help strengthen the Kia ownership experience and support our transformation into a leading provider of sustainable mobility solutions. We also extend our sincere gratitude to Juma Al Majid Group for its valued partnership and contribution to Kia's success in the UAE. The strong foundation they established will support Kia's next phase of growth," said Hoo Gon Kim, President, Kia Middle East & Africa.

Under the agreement, Al Tayer Motors will oversee Kia's sales, service, parts, and after-sales operations across Dubai & the Northern Emirates, while Premier Motors will handle these operations in Abu Dhabi & Al Ain. Existing warranties, service agreements, and after-sales support for Kia vehicles in the country will continue without interruption and will be fully honoured by Al Tayer Motors and Premier Motors.

The partnership supports Kia's ongoing transformation towards electrification and sustainable mobility, aligned with the UAE's ambitions for innovation and sustainability.

For more information, please visit Al Tayer Motors or contact 800 MOTORS.

About Al Tayer Motors

Al Tayer Motors was established in 1982 and represents major European, American and Asian automobile manufacturers Ford, Lincoln, Jaguar, Land Rover, Ferrari, Maserati, Ford Trucks, Foton, VinFast and DEEPAL across the UAE. 

With a growing network of sales, service and parts centres across Dubai, Sharjah, Abu Dhabi, Ras Al Khaimah and Fujairah, the dedicated team of more than 3,100 professionals is committed to taking customer satisfaction to higher levels.

In Abu Dhabi, Ford, Lincoln, Jaguar, Land Rover, Ferrari, Maserati, Ford Trucks, Foton, VinFast and DEEPAL are represented by Al Tayer Motors through Premier Motors.

About Kia Corporation 

Kia (www.kia.com) is a global mobility brand with a vision to create sustainable mobility solutions for consumers, communities, and societies around the world. Founded in 1944, Kia has been providing mobility solutions for more than 80 years. With 52,000 employees worldwide, a presence in more than 190 markets, and manufacturing facilities in six countries, the company today sells around three million vehicles a year. Kia is spearheading the popularization of electrified and battery electric vehicles and developing a growing range of mobility services, encouraging millions of people around the world to explore the best ways of getting around. The company’s brand slogan – ‘Movement that inspires’ – reflects Kia’s commitment to inspire consumers through its products and services.
